claims.claim_ar: استعمال «بالسنين» ككنية أو استبدال للدلالة على سنوات القحط والشدة بالمجاز
claims.claim_en: Use of «bi-s-sinīn» (with the years) as a kināyah (metonymy) to signify years of drought and hardship rather than neutral chronological years.
claims.rhetorical_effect: Condenses a complex socio-environmental reality (drought, famine) into a short phrase, intensifying the sense of punishment and prompting reflection.

claims.claim_ar: استعمال «لعل» للدلالة على رجاء/إمكان أن يتذكروا، مع دلالة اللام على معنى دعوى الاستحقاق كما ذُكر في التفسير
claims.claim_en: Use of «laʿalla» to express hope/possibility that they may remember; the commentary also notes the لام (lam) signals an asserted claim of deserving the reminder.
claims.rhetorical_effect: Frames the calamity as a potential moral lesson — the particle turns a factual report into a didactic exhortation, inviting self-reflection.
